probe.source:
defmodule QaA693 do
  def tool(name) do
    try do
      {out, code} = System.cmd(name, ["--version"], stderr_to_stdout: true)
      "exit=#{code} #{String.trim(out)}"
    rescue
      ErlangError -> "unavailable"
    end
  end
  def body do
    "QA_A693_ELIXIR\nelixir=#{System.version()}\notp=#{System.otp_release()}\n" <>
      Enum.map_join(["node", "npm", "yarn", "pnpm"], "\n", fn name -> "#{name}=#{tool(name)}" end) <> "\n"
  end
  def serve(listener) do
    {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.accept(listener)
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 5000) do
      {:ok, _request} ->
        payload = body()
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: #{byte_size(payload)}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n" <> payload)
      _ -> :ok
    end
    :gen_tcp.close(socket)
    serve(listener)
  end
end
port = System.get_env("PORT", "8080") |> String.to_integer()
{:ok, listener} = :gen_tcp.listen(port, [:binary, active: false, reuseaddr: true, packet: :raw])
IO.puts("QA_A693_ELIXIR ready")
QaA693.serve(listener)
